title: Learning ledger state
description: The memory ledger's .state.json: the watermarks of the last observations reflected, the schedule marks of each job, and the mute switch. A watermark advances only when a reflection is accepted, so a rejected rewrite is retried on the same evidence rather than skipping it (protocol evidence-gate). The file lives in the runtime's ledger directory, never inside a project repository (ruling learning-runtime-is-host-adapter).

last_worker_obs_id_reflected.description: Highest runtime-owned offline worker observation accepted by reflection.

last_reflect_attempt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the latest failed or rejected reflection.

reflect_stalled_since.description: Epoch milliseconds of the first failed or rejected reflection since the last accepted reflection. Retries preserve this time; acceptance clears it. Review ingest uses it for the staleness window in adapters/observation-source/CONTRACT.md.

reflect_process_failure.description: Authentication failure or timeout from the latest reflect or backfill judge call. Absent after a call without either failure or an accepted reflection. Backfill hold timing is defined in adapters/observation-source/CONTRACT.md.

last_nightly.description: Local calendar date of the last nightly run.

last_nightly_attempt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the latest failed nightly run.
